description: Raised for stage-fatal analysis failures: unknown run_id, or enrichment never having completed for the run.
docstring:
Stage-fatal analysis failure.

Raised by run_analysis when run_id does not exist, or when games_enriched is empty AND no prior enrichment stage_complete event exists for the run (distinguishing this from a legitimately empty candidate set that enrichment itself completed successfully with zero rows). NOT raised for a small-but-nonzero candidate set, a degenerate clustering, or any single-archetype/zero-variance condition -- those are handled and reported, not raised, per the module's own design.
postconditions: An AnalysisError propagating out of run_analysis results in the run's status being set to 'failed' via orchestration's exception-to-terminal-status translation

edge_cases.input: run_analysis called for a run_id where enrichment was never invoked at all
run_analysis called for a run_id that legitimately has zero enriched rows because the candidate set was empty
edge_cases.expected_behavior: NOT raised; stage succeeds with empty-but-well-formed results, per run_analysis's own edge case

unit_tests.name: test_enrichment_never_run_raises
unit_tests.description: A run_id with no enrichment stage_complete event and zero games_enriched rows raises AnalysisError.

unit_tests.name: test_legitimately_empty_candidate_set_does_not_raise
unit_tests.description: A run_id where enrichment completed successfully with zero rows does not raise.
unit_tests.expected: no exception; AnalysisReport with all-zero counts
